chapter: Forest Boar Pauses for the Bloom
act_title: Forest Boar Pauses for the Bloom

quests.title: Forest Boar Pauses for the Bloom

dialogue.t: *sigh* Not again... Why does this keep happening? The field's a mess...
At this rate, I won't be able to deliver the flowers on time. What am I supposed to tell my customers?
Look at this. The whole field's wrecked... These flowers were coming in beautifully, and now they're ruined.
I know, right? ...Well. Not human at all, actually. It's a forest boar.
For some reason, it keeps coming down here lately, nibbling the flowers and then flopping around in the middle of the field.
And it's slippery. The moment anyone hears it and heads over, it takes off. Just now it nearly barreled into an elderly man passing by...
It's outrageous. This fellow's a real boor, I tell you!
Oh — wait... hold on. Aren't you the Honorary Knight? The hero who saved Mondstadt? Then please, I really need your help.
That's such a relief... I think it headed toward the valley.
It's a clever beastie. You might have to lure it out with flowers... though, well, you can see what's left of mine...
Maybe grab a few Windrest Flowers along the way and use them as bait. Would serve it right to get fooled for once!
*sigh* These poor flowers are completely ruined. Now I'll have to replant the whole patch... honestly...
Oh — you're back? How did it go?
Ah, thank you so much. Here, this is for your trouble.
Now I can finally get the flower field back in order. Let's just hope no more "inhuman" visitors show up again...

quests.description: …Near the flower field of Millhaven, now left in disarray, you notice a woman sighing in frustration. A brief exchange reveals the cause of the chaos — a forest boar has been trampling the flowers…
